bible-genesis-kjv: Genesis, the first book of the King James Bible, tells the great origin stories of the Judeo-Christian tradition. It opens with God creating the world in six days, then moves through Adam and Eve, Noah’s flood, and the lives of Abraham, Jacob, and Joseph. Written in the majestic English of the 1611 King James translators. It remains the most widely read version of these ancient stories in the English-speaking world.
